[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35063584/ee1a659bf0917d6c00ca79d4fb830245097bd5c6.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Hey, friends![/b]

We are [b]happy to announce[/b] that we already [b]fixed more than 15 reported bugs[/b] and issues since the release! And we also added the much-requested [b][u]ability to skip the text from the very beginning of the game[/u][/b].
